descripcion_html:
3 soap dispenser solution for use on shower walls or in any space where you need to have a soap dispenser on hand.

Package Contents
  • 3 PET dispensers (plastic) with soap rope
  • 3 x wall mounting brackets, with adhesive included.
  • High contrast PVC stickers are waterproof and easily readable.
  • 1 level to install the straight bracket.
  • 1 booklet with graphic instructions (English language not guaranteed).

Wall Mount Brackets

The brackets are made of matt black lacquered aluminium, water and moisture resistant. They should be attached to walls with smooth, waterproof coatings, such as tiles, vinyl plates or glass. The drying time (cure of the adhesive) is 72 hours.

Each holder holds at least 7.5kg, enough to use without fear of peeling off. Once glued, they can be peeled off and leave no marks. If you have a hard time taking them off, insert an old credit card between the holder and the wall and press hard in different positions. When you have peeled off the holder, remove the remnants of glue adhered with the same card and finish cleaning with a kitchen paper and alcohol.

The holders are suitable for attaching any standard metric 28mm bottle.

stickers

Included in the package are 2 sheets of 6 removable stickers: 6 with white background and another 6 with black background. The letters are easily readable so we do not mistake boat, ideal for hotels and tourist apartments. The stickers are made of PVC, fully waterproof and waterproof.

Mounting without drilling.

The use of adhesives to fix elements in wet environments is the perfect system to avoid moisture problems from water filtration. The adhesive included is a type of high strength silicone with additives that prevent the formation of mold.

Product Cleaning

Dispensers and holder should be cleaned avoiding scratching their surface with limescale. An optimal method is to use a brush with plastic bristles (a used nail brush) and rinse with plenty of water.
